hooks.command: path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|html|scss|css)$' || exit 0; npx prettier --write "$path"
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.ts$' || exit 0; npx ng lint --fix 2>&1 || true
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.ts$' || exit 0; npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit || (echo 'Type errors found — Claude should fix these' && exit 1)
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); echo "$path" | grep -qE '\.spec\.ts$' || exit 0; npx ng test --watch=false --test-path-pattern="$path" || true
path=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); [ "$path" != *"environment.prod.ts"* ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Do not edit prod environment file directly"}' >&2; exit 2; }
